scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @latex/api" "npm run dev -w @latex/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @latex/domain && npm run build -w @latex/api && npm run build -w @latex/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @latex/domain && npm run test -w @latex/domain && npm run test -w @latex/api && npm run test -w @latex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @latex/domain && npm run typecheck -w @latex/api && npm run typecheck -w @latex/web
